title: Dinner Lady Fruit Full Cherry Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dinner Lady’s Fruit Full Cherry Ice delivers a rich and vibrant blend of deep, juicy Cherries paired with a crisp burst of cooling Ice. The bold, sweet flavour of ripe Cherries unfolds with a rich, slightly tangy depth, while the icy finish adds a fresh and uplifting contrast for a perfectly balanced vape. Part of the Fruit Full Bar Salts collection, Cherry Ice is crafted to replicate the punchy, layered flavours often found in disposable vapes. Using a double-concentrated Nic Salt formula, this e-liquid ensures long-lasting, full-bodied flavour while maintaining a smooth and satisfying vape experience. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this e-liquid provides an excellent balance of vapour production and flavour clarity, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. The nicotine salt formulation delivers a smooth throat hit and fast nicotine satisfaction, making it best suited for use with pod kits and classic vape starter devices. Since 2016, Dinner Lady has been crafting premium e-liquids that are now enjoyed in over 80 countries worldwide. Their commitment to high-quality ingredients and expertly developed blends continues to make them a favourite among vapers. Elevate your refillable vape device or starter pod kit with this convenient, beginner-friendly e-liquid.
